Now, content plan: The story so far — Day 41 morning, they found an old frame 100 paces outside the mouth with a man-made opening 4尺长, edges flush, width 一拃半, matching the cut face of the probe half (batch 二九四). Inside the opening it's black, and霜 doesn't form on the inner end. They decided to approach (半天油) — 100 paces each way, half day fuel.

So chapter 35: approach the frame, find it's a wrecked calibration frame (废校准架) — old, hunched, with anchor connection destroyed. They can't dock normally since the frame has no functioning mooring; they have to tie off安全索. Find inside a hull-like structure / rack where the calibration ship (丙字三一四) was... Actually the frame is a "校准架" — a calibration gantry where ships' 潮势解算 got calibrated against a table. So the "剖口" is an opening someone cut in a plate to reach into the frame's interior, and the depth goes to a compartment where the calibration ship's external recording cylinder (外接记录筒) sits — meaning: either the calibration ship docked there and its external 筒 was mounted, or the frame is where the ship's data was read. Hmm, need a coherent physical story.

Design: The frame is an old calibrating stand (校准架) — a structure of 4 beams + plate, originally part of a 封航段's 校准支线 (the calibration branch line mentioned in 台一七 logs: 丙字三一四 was registered as 曾经开放的校准支线). So the entrance to the 校准支线 is exactly this frame — the frame is the mouth/anchor point of a calibration branch. Ships going into the branch docked at the frame to have their 走法 measured against the calibration table (机册 recorded 离台前量一串十二位数 — the calibration measurement).

The opening cut in the plate leads into the frame's interior — where the calibration stand's reading equipment / a 外接记录筒 (external recorder cylinder) is. The calibration ship 丙字三一四 came here ~19 months ago; the crew died in the cabin per the case file (验作冻毙却无霜). Hmm, but where's the ship? Body of the case: three died in the cabin of the calibration ship. So maybe the calibration ship isn't here — this is a different frame. But the 探针半截 with hard stamp 批二九四 was collected by 陆徊 at the 未登记礁区 (chapter 6: 礁上一条笔直的带子与合衔探针残件). So the probe half is a piece of a 合衔 probe — same batch as... 

The outline says: "探针半截的批次与校准架的接口一致" — the probe's batch matches the calibration frame's interface. Hmm: "接口一致" — meaning the probe's cut/receiving face matches the frame's interface port; i.e., the probe half was originally installed in this kind of frame, same batch 二九四. So the probe was part of a set of instruments delivered to this calibration frame, and the frame's socket carries a stamp of the same batch. That forms a material link: the 探针残件 (collected months ago at an unregistered reef, where the 合衔 probe was found) came from a batch intended for these calibration frames — proving the official side set up these frames (and/or the "笔直的带子" and 灰边 world's probe). Reasonable.

So the record cylinder: the calibration frame has an 外接记录筒 (external recorder) that logs ships that docked and were measured. The last entry: the calibration ship 丙字三一四. And there's a 撤回指令 (recall/withdraw order) that got overwritten, with subsequent 航行执行 still marked 按许可走.

Hmm — careful: hook for 35 is "记录筒中最后一道撤回指令被覆盖，其后的航行执行仍标着按许可走。" So the cylinder contains a record where a recall instruction existed, then was overwritten (covered/patched), then the vessel went and executed 按许可走. So they discover that: someone withdrew/canceled the recall? Actually "被覆盖" means the recall order line was overwritten by something else. Meaning: an order to recall/撤回 was issued (perhaps instructing the ship not to go), but it was overwritten, and the log continues to show 按许可走 — i.e., the ship continued per the license. This undermines the "误闯" explanation and the "someone recalled them but it didn't take" story. But chapter 36 will interpret it. In 35 they just recover the cylinder and see the physical fact; the hook can be the last readable line.

Careful: 35's hook should be the discovery of the overwritten recall order. But who reads it in ch 35? Maybe they can't read it fully — they copy the readable part and 祁昭 notices the last 段 where a line is written twice (overwritten) with 按许可走 after. Maybe they only get a partial glimpse — the 撤回指令 line has been re-inscribed over, and 祁昭 can read the pattern. Let's have them power up the cylinder (needs power — hence "不切断供电": the cylinder's internal buffer loses content if power is cut; 陆徊 pulls it while keeping the frame's trickle supply connected, or he keeps a capacitor/backup cell wired — that's the craftsman feat).

Design the mechanism concretely:
- The 外接记录筒 (external log cylinder) is mounted in a socket inside the frame; it's a rotating drum with a magnetic/晶面 surface written by a stylus; its read/write head erases the segment on write (覆写) — which explains the overwritten line physically. So the "覆盖" is not sabotage, it's the device's normal write behavior? Hmm, but the hook implies meaningful: a recall order was written, then overwritten, and the navigation execution log after that still says 按许可走. Could be that the cylinder's format writes sequentially and a later write overran an earlier instruction slot. The mystery: who wrote, and what order.

Better to keep it as physical fact: in the cylinder's last fold, one line (a 撤回指令 slot — a standard field "撤回/放行") shows two layers of writing — the older one is a 撤回 mark, the newer one overwrote it, and the following 执行 lines all carry the 按许可走 stamp. So there was an order to hold back, and something replaced it and let the ship go. But we must not explain who. Also, careful with 阑/静庭 later: chapter 40 says 阑承认前哨曾收到停止放行的请求 (a request to stop letting them out) but its timing... Actually ch40: "停止放行的请求早于校准船失事，真正执行封闭却在事故之后。" So the recall request existed before the accident. The ch35 hook plants that.

Also careful: the cylinder's data is "外接记录筒" external to the ship? "校准船的外接记录筒" — the calibration ship's external recorder. Hmm, "外接" could mean "externally mounted" (mounted on the outside of the ship). So the calibration frame has a socket where a ship's external recorder cylinder is docked and read — the calibration stand reads the ship's external log to verify 走法. So when the calibration ship docked here 19 months ago, its 外接筒 was plugged into the frame's reader, and the ship left/destroyed... but the cylinder remained, because the socket retains it? Hmm. Or: the frame's own recording socket has the ship's cylinder still in it — meaning someone removed the cylinder from the ship and left it here, or the ship's external cylinder got stuck in the reader.

Actually the most concrete, physical version: 外接记录筒 is a detachable drum that sits in an external socket on the frame (所有停靠的船都把自己的筒插进来，架上的量具把该船这一趟的走法刻在筒上，船带走筒). The frame's socket number shows batch 二九四. The 探针半截 has 批二九四 — the probe was part of the same instrument set/consignment as this frame's interface. That means the instruments at the unregistered reef (where the probe was found) and this frame came from the same 批 — official supply batch. Good and simple.

And inside the frame, in a sealed compartment behind the cut plate, sits a cylinder that was never taken away — because the last ship (丙字三一四) never got to take it back. So it contains the calibration ship's record: what it measured, what 走法 it was licensed for, and the last lines: 撤回指令 slot overwritten, then 执行按许可走.

Hmm, but the cylinder being "the calibration ship's" external recorder left in the frame — meaning on the day of the accident the ship plugged in its cylinder, ran the calibration (measuring 离台前量那一串十二位数 — consistent with 机册 at 台一七: "离台前量一串十二位数"), and left the cylinder in the socket? Unusual. Alternative: after the accident, someone brought the cylinder here and socketed it (evidence planted/stored). Or the cylinder belongs to the frame (the frame records every visit) and carries the record of all ships that used it, with the last entry being 丙字三一四. This last is cleaner: the frame's own 记录筒 records visits. And "外接" because it is externally mounted (outside the frame's sealed interior), reachable via the opening someone cut.

But why did someone cut a hole in the plate with a tool (两道边齐平、不是裂的)? Answer: someone else came here before them and cut into the frame to get at the recorder — but didn't take it? Or cut in and stopped (口子里头黑、霜结不上 — hmm, 霜结不上去 suggests the interior is warm-ish? Actually 霜结不上 means frost can't form → the inside is not cold; maybe there's still residual heat — i.e., still drawing power/heat). If the interior is warm, that suggests something inside is still live. That supports "不切断供电" — the cylinder still has power trickle; if they cut the power, the buffer writes/erases.

So: someone cut the plate open (with a proper tool, edges flush), looked in, and left it — didn't take the cylinder. Who? Unknown (老炳 can only say it was cut with a tool, edges flush, can't say who). Good — mystery retained. The 剖口 opens access.

But careful with "陆徊凭拆解手艺在不切断供电的情况下取出记录" — the challenge: the cylinder is wired; pulling the plug causes a cold-cut that drops the record's last buffer (the most recent fold) or scrambles it; so he keeps the frame's trickle supply alive using his own terminal's cell / a jumper, bridging while he detaches the cylinder, so that the drum keeps its indexing and the last fold stays readable. That's a great craftsman set-piece consistent with "少切两刀".

Time pressure: 穆婶 gave 半天油 = 100 paces each way + work time. So a limited stay. Also they're using 油 per hour.

Approach: they cast across 100 paces; the frame is bigger than seen; no mooring — 老炳 has to rig lines (系安全索); 穆婶 stays with the shell (船) — or the shell itself can't dock, so they tether the shell to the frame's 梁? Let's end on her writing it into her page and one question, or on 陆徊 looking at the 探针半截 socketed (they could actually plug the probe half into the socket — the interface matches! That's a great beat: 探针半截 fits the socket — "探针半截的批次与校准架的接口一致" → he inserts the probe half into the socket and it seats — proving it was part of this instrument set). Because probe and cylinder share a bus/interface standard of 批二九四 — the instruments were one set: 探针、记录筒、量具 all from batch 二九四 supplied to these calibration frames. Actually simpler and more concrete: 探针半截 slides into the 记录筒's 备用位置 (a spare bay) and the bay's 卡口 holds it — the batch号 stamped on both sides of the same interface.
